በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ዘቦቱ: በ — who has (ዘ- relative + preposition በ + -ቱ '3ms'; ቦቱ 'in him', expressing possession: 'he who has')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ለውእቱ: ውእቱ — of that, that (ለ- 'of, to' + demonstrative ውእቱ before a noun: ለውእቱ መጽሐፍ 'of that book') · ለ- marking the object before a demonstrative (ይነጽሮ ለውእቱ ሥዕለ 'let him look at that image')
ወዘበጦ: ዘበጠ — and he struck him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, z-b-ṭ, + -ኦ '3ms him')
ወቀተሎ: ቀተለ — and he killed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant') · they made (3mp perfect of ገብረ, G, g-b-r; ገብሩ አህጉረ 'they made cities')
አንሥኦ: አንሥአ — he raised him up (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, n-ś-ʾ; + -ኦ 'him')
ወሐቀፎ: ሐቀፈ — and he embraced him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
ወነገፎ: ነገፈ — and he shook him (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, n-g-f + -o 'him'); the root sense is uncertain (?)
ቅብአ: ቅብእ — anointing (noun, construct 'anointing of'; verbal noun of ቀብአ)
ወአንበሮ: አንበረ — and he set him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ነበረ 'sit, dwell' + -ኦ 'him')
በየማኑ: የማን — at his right hand (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ንጉሥሰ: ንጉሥ — the king indeed (noun + ሰ 'indeed, on the other hand')
በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
ዘእቤ: ብህለ — which I speak of, say (ዘ- relative + 1s imperfect እቤ, b-h-l)
ወአዳም: አዳም — and pleasantness (?) (ወ- + noun or adjective, perhaps from አደመ 'please'; sense uncertain) · ወአዳም ምሕረትከ 'and pleasing (?) your mercy': read as an adjective matching መንክር (?) · and pleasing (?) (ወ- + adjective, as in ch. 25-26 and 35), in ወአዳም ሥና 'and pleasing (?) beauty (?)'
ወርእዮ: ርእየ — and he saw him (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -o, r-ʾ-y) · and seeing, and when he saw (ወ- + infinitive ርእዮ, circumstantial, with accusative object ዘንተ 'this')
ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
ወአንሥኦ: አንሥአ — and he raised him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, n-ś-ʾ + -ኦ 'him'; subject not stated) · or here perhaps ወ- + infinitive አንሥኦ 'and to lift up', before ኵናቶ (?)
ለአዳም: አዳም — of/for Adam · Adam as object, marked with ለ- (ሤሞ ለአዳም 'he appointed Adam') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (ስሕተቱ ለአዳም 'Adam's error') and in apposition (ላዕሌሁ ለአዳም 'upon him, upon Adam')
አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
አንበሮ: አንበረ — he settled him, set him (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ነበረ 'dwell', + -ሁ 'him')
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ወሊቃነ: ሊቅ — and chiefs of (ወ- + plural construct ሊቃነ)
መንፈሳዊያን: መንፈሳዊ — spiritual ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
ወ: ወ — and (conjunction, written as a separate word before ይቤሉ) · also a separate word before በደኃሪ ባሕር ('and in the last sea')
ወአፍቀሮ: አፍቀረ — love, be fond of (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, f-ḳ-r + -ኦ 'him', 3ms)
ወመሐሮ: መሐረ — and he forgave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
ለነዳይ: ነዳይ — to the poor (ለ- + adjective used as a noun)
ለምስኪን: ምስኪን — to the needy, poor (ለ- + noun)
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
